A '''spitapillar''' was a creature native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Secrets">''[[Super Star Wars Official Game Secrets]]''</ref> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] encountered one inside a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]].<ref name="SSW">''[[Super Star Wars]]''</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This strange creature is the mini-boss in the [[Wikipedia:Super Nintendo Entertainment System|Super Nintendo]] game ''[[Super Star Wars]]''.<ref name="SSW" /> The player first encounters it on "Level 4: Inside the Sandcrawler." In the game, this creature can spit fireballs from its mouth and four limbs.
''[[Super Star Wars Official Game Secrets]]'' calls it a "Spitapillar".<ref name="Secrets" />
